title: Fix Lowpoly Dev Boot
description: lowpoly wgpu dev shows blank screen because plugin manifest parse fails (missing surfaceKind) or returns empty apps due to stale plugin WASM / broken plugin init hook linkage.
summary:
The original root cause (stale semio-framework-plugin rlib referencing an old plugin init hook, producing an empty manifest with no surfaceKind) was already fixed in this ticket's prior session by rebuilding the plugin WASM artifacts — re-confirmed here: booting lowpoly under wgpu today (isolated dev server, port 6178) loads a valid manifest (apps present, surfaceKind set) with zero manifest-parse errors.

Added the durable guards this ticket asked for, in framework/renderer/wgpu/js/boot.ts: `validatePluginManifest` now rejects a manifest with no apps or a window kind missing `surfaceKind` with a clear `[DEBUG]` error instead of silently proceeding; the whole boot sequence is wrapped in try/catch that renders a visible DOM error banner (red, full-screen, monospace) into `#root` instead of leaving a diagnostic-free blank canvas, so a future manifest regression fails loudly in the browser instead of reproducing this ticket's original "blank screen with no error" symptom.

Verified live: rebuilt and reloaded the lowpoly wgpu dev server — console shows transient plugin-worker timeout/restart noise (pre-existing retry logic, unrelated to this fix, likely environment resource contention) followed by a clean `[DEBUG] wgpu renderer booted`, `wasmBindings` present, canvas created, and no error banner rendered (confirming the manifest validation correctly did not fire a false positive). Pixel-level visual confirmation was not possible — this headless Browser pane does not present WebGPU canvas output (confirmed separately via a non-WebGPU screenshot sanity check and documented in the sibling FIX-WGPU-WINDOW-OPTIONS-CHIP-Z-ORDER ticket); boot success was confirmed via console/DOM state instead.
